personal.intro_zh: 我的研究贯穿魔药学、魔法材料学与黑魔法防御术，探索药剂分子在坩埚中的相互作用与边界。
personal.intro_en: My research spans potion-making, magical materials and defence against the dark arts, probing how potion molecules interact at the edge of the cauldron.
personal.label_zh: 魔药学 / 魔法材料学

lab.title_zh:
熬制魔药，
连接咒语与发现。
lab.intro_zh: 围绕魔药学、魔法材料与防御术，开发开放、可复现的配方与实验流程。
lab.intro_en: We explore potions, magical materials and defensive arts through open, reproducible recipes and protocols.

research_interests.zh: 魔药学、魔法材料学、黑魔法防御、药剂可复现性。
research_interests.en: Potion-making; magical materials; defence against the dark arts; potion reproducibility.

research.desc_zh: 面向大规模坩埚数据的配方分析方法，探索药剂注释、材料来源推断与功能模块。
research.desc_en: Developing methods for large-scale cauldron data, ingredient annotation, origin inference and functional module analysis.

research.desc_zh: 整合材料学、咒语学与黑魔法防御，研究药剂与结界相互作用的分子机制。
research.desc_en: Integrating materials, spellwork and defensive theory to study how potions interact with wards at the molecular level.

research.title_zh: 开放配方与可复现实验
research.desc_zh: 使用标准化坩埚与工作流系统，把魔药配方转化为易于复现、可共享的科研工具。
research.desc_en: Turning potion recipes into accessible, reusable research tools with standardized cauldrons and reproducible workflows.
